nature: AI-generated original high-resolution source (1774x887) with soft alpha; NOT hand-placed native pixel art. Depicts A-Lei, a fictional adult flower-nursery farmer designed for this game. No real person was named or referenced, and it is not a licensed or existing character.

assets.layout: two equal 887x887 panels: left = full-body standing NPC, right = head-and-shoulders dialogue portrait of the same character

integration: Copied byte for byte (sha256 matches the source); no pixel edits and no Python/Pillow image editing. scripts/flower_resident_art.gd takes each window with Image.get_region, resizes it to native size with Image.INTERPOLATE_NEAREST and caches it, using the same pipeline as flower_art.gd. Each window has exactly the native aspect ratio, so nothing is stretched. Godot import is lossless (compress/mode=0) with no mipmaps.
alpha: Faint haze (alpha 1-8) spreads across both panels, and edges are soft. Both are kept rather than thresholded. At native size the resident has 609 solid, 10 soft (64-223) and 59 ghost (1-63) pixels; the portrait has 2226 solid, 19 soft and 115 ghost pixels.
status: Native 1x/4x galleries on grass and paper reviewed (work/flowers/resident-check). Usable as a display-only adapter. Not production-certified pixel art, and it has not been reviewed in-world.
